g.text: (b) By gap since the last valid attempt

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #25211e

g.text: Does a retry set a new personal best?

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #685c52

g.text: New best / eligible retries · S = distinct eligible contributors

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: Eligible: a scored retry while the prior within-window best is below 100.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: First scores, internal errors and retries after full credit are excluded.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: Equal scores do not count as new bests.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: Gap bins are clock time, not study time. Events repeat within students; no causal comparison.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52

g.text: Long-gap percentages have small denominators. Read counts alongside rates.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #685c52
